title: Sethmojis
blurb: Seth re-performs reaction memes: Wan Animate 2 motion transfer on gpu-worker, cast style via the f0llie5 LoRA. Click any emoji for the side-by-side and the full-size version.

notes.best-friends: shot/reverse-shot: each shot rendered with its own ref and spliced (stepbros.py)
notes.best-friends-jen: Jen drawn in the cast style answers 'YEP!'
notes.chefkiss: animated from a live-action chef; also a static still and a two-frame kiss loop
notes.elaine: full-body, so the emoji is a small figure; the motion still reads
notes.hangin: Beetlejuice's outfit, captions on the original timing
notes.its-happening: v2: on the original lasers with Ron painted out; the caption blinks on the source's own frames
notes.mind-blown: v2: turtleneck and 80s glasses; the boom is added in post (MindBlownFX node) over the 2.5s the render skips
notes.more: still only: Oliver Twist's 'Please sir, may I have some more?'
notes.nod: keeps Redford's beard; plays at 6fps to fit 128KB
notes.popeye: eyes by MiniMax H3 between two pupil-edited frames; the source was too small for Wan to read the gaze
notes.slow-clap: weakest: the source is so soft the hands read as chin-rubbing, not clapping
notes.squidward: cartoon source: one repainted frame, moved by the original's own optical flow (FlowTransfer node) at 2x, 6 poses at the original 12.5fps
notes.squidward-body: full cast-style Seth posed from Squidward frame 0, then MiniMax H3 image-to-video (pose pinned both ends) for the twerk itself
notes.thats-bait: THAT'S / BAIT timed to the original subtitles, BAIT flashing (Captions post mode); emoji text is drawn on the cutout
notes.top-kek: El Risitas; keeps the pink backdrop; gap teeth inpainted into the ref
notes.van-door: Wan Animate moves people, not props: the door is drawn and slid shut in post (SlidingDoorFX node)
notes.yo-dawg: no motion source: RecursiveZoom node nests Seth on his own forehead
notes.this-reaction-here: team request: upload as :seth-this-reaction-here: and drop it to the RIGHT of the reaction you're laughing at. Motion from Kevin Hart's ice-bath point.
notes.gotcha: Dave Chappelle's GOTCHA BITCH. The source caption was painted out of the driving clip (delogo) and redrawn in post on the original's timing.
notes.chest-thump: recast into the real shot: SCAIL-2 swaps McConaughey for cartoon Seth, the restaurant stays real (sethmoji_recast.py)
notes.thats-the-rule: recast into the real SNL Weekend Update shot with SCAIL-2; the burned-in caption is the original's pixels
